name: OpenSubtitles
description: Search and download subtitles in many languages from OpenSubtitles.com, matched by file hash, provider ID or title. Sign in with your own account.

descriptionI18n.zh-TW: 從 OpenSubtitles.com 搜尋並下載多種語言的字幕，依檔案雜湊、提供者 ID 或片名配對。請用你自己的帳號登入。
descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 从 OpenSubtitles.com 搜索并下载多种语言的字幕，按文件哈希、提供者 ID 或片名匹配。请用你自己的账号登录。
